assessments.reasoning: Section 5.2.1.4 at pp.46–47 explicitly assigns private accessibility to a procedural module containing Option Private Module. It makes a module omitting the directive accessible within its own project and any projects referencing that project.

challenge.method: Check the directive production and both static branches on p.47. Try applying the module rule to a single declaration and to the class-module branch of the grammar on p.42.
challenge.results: The normative subject at p.47 is the procedural module itself. The next bullet directs individual declaration effects to §5.2.3. Class modules and downstream host settings have separate controls.

limitations: This judgment applies to the exact May 20, 2025 MS-VBAL revision 2.4. The publisher currently lists a later edition. Its requirements and behavior of any Office host are outside this review.
The conclusion follows the named project relationships and excludes declaration-specific rules and class-module access.
